system.description: While you have 5 or more Nature Energy, you can spend your Bonus action to spend 2 Nature Energy to release a raw burst of concentrated Nature Energy in the form of a terrifying roar. All creatures within 20 feet of your must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, affected creatures are pushed back 10 feet, and gain 2 ranks of Demoralized.
